remarks: HIGHEST & BEST DUE MONDAY, JULY 28 AT 12 NOON. This property is perfectly situated within the Rowayton Woods Community, offering direct views of the pond and convenient access to the heated pool and tennis courts. This renovated ranch-style unit is located on the second level, with only a few steps to the entrance. It is a rare three-bedroom unit featuring two full baths, which has been tastefully updated and freshly painted. Unit boasts chic hardwood composite floors, range/microwave (2021), refrigerator (2023), kitchen backsplash (2023), HVAC system (2019), hot water heater (2022), hall bathroom new tile flooring (2023), washer/dryer (2023). Addl enhancements include closet systems, recessed lighting, crown molding, window blinds, and new door hinges and knobs. The spacious living room features a wood-burning fireplace with a rustic wood mantle, custom built-ins, and slider doors that lead to a covered private deck area, perfect for relaxing and entertaining. There is also an assigned parking space (#144) conveniently located near the unit, along with additional visitor parking for guests. A separate and secure storage area is located above the garage, across from unit. Rowayton Woods is a sought-after complex renowned for its numerous amenities, spanning 22 acres of extensive landscaping plus a community garden. The property is walking distance to the Metro North train station and is close to Bayley Beach and Rowayton Village with its restaurants and quaint shops.
